timeline.body:
Motivation:

Netty uses epoll edge-triggered by default forever and there is really not reason why someone should use level-triggered (its considered a implementation detail).

Modifications:

- Remove code that was related to level-triggered mode
- Adjust testclass names

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/9349

timeline.message:
Remove support for epoll level-triggered

Motivation:

Netty uses epoll edge-triggered by default forever and there is really not reason why someone should use level-triggered (its considered a implementation detail).

Modifications:

- Remove code that was related to level-triggered mode
- Adjust testclass names

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/9349
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body: The comment above still references edgeTriggered mode

LGTM, thanks!

I think there's some nice follow-on simplifications which could now be made along the lines of #9347. I can try and do that soon since it should be pretty quick (I haven't forgotten about the master branch porting backlog too :))

WDYT about making the same change for 4.1 (of course LT would still appear in the API but have no effect)? I know the splicing function is documented to require LT but is that really the case? I guess we could wait to see the extent of the simplifications/optimizations that this opens up before deciding whether it's worth it...
